props.label: Painting Leichhardt, inside and out
props.html:
Local painters in Leichhardt

Painting Leichhardt, inside and out

Leichhardt — the Inner West’s “Little Italy” — is defined by its Victorian terraces, from grand two-storey rows to modest single-fronters, plus a good number of Federation semis. Painting them well is about respecting the era: crisp heritage colours, properly prepared render and iron lacework, and interiors that suit high ceilings and ornate cornices.

props.label: Homes we paint in Leichhardt
props.html:
Leichhardt housing

Homes we paint in Leichhardt

  • Victorian terraces Single and double-fronted terraces with rendered or face-brick facades and decorative parapets.
  • Federation semis Paired homes with tuckpointing, timber detail and generous verandahs.
  • Renovated cottages Updated interiors where sharp modern finishes meet original period features.

props.html:
Why local matters

Painters who know Leichhardt

Terrace painting is its own craft — tight street frontages, shared party walls, ornate parapets and iron lace all need patience and the right access. We’ve done plenty of it around Norton Street and know how to get a heritage-appropriate result.

Good to know

Painting in Leichhardt — a common question

Can you match heritage colours for a Leichhardt terrace?
Absolutely. We work from heritage and National Trust palettes and can colour-match existing schemes so your terrace’s facade, iron lace and trims stay true to its Victorian character.
